_doc: Nhạn Trận Môn's Effect engine records (world-depth Stage 6; ADR-0009). Merged into assets/data/combat_effects.json under source world-depth:nhan_tran. Unpriced. Rule text from design/world/depth/sects/nhan_tran.items.json.

One Goose.rule: Standard of the First File: the standard is raised at the start of the fight; while it stands you take 15 % less damage, and every 6 s it takes the first share of the next blow that deals health damage (30 % of the hit healed back).

Geese Line.rule: Standard of the First File (d17): while the standard stands (+8) and while Geese Stance holds (+8), you gain +8 block rating for each anchor of the file.

Last Man in the File.rule: Out of the Grey, full set (3 pieces): while the raised standard stands, you gain +20 block rating as though you had raised the shield, and each blocked hit lets you shed 1 Wood poison stack and 1 Corpse Rot miasma stack (once every 3 s).

Take the Wind.rule: Point of the File, full set (2 pieces): you take 10 % less damage, and each block you make raises a stance ward worth 1.5 % of your health.
